name: default
description: Search the graph by relationship, bring the messages those facts were stated in, and add raw-turn retrieval.

name: graph-facts
description: The graph only, searched by relationship, with the source messages of the facts found.

name: graph-entities
description: The graph only, searched by entity, with the facts around each hit and their source messages.

name: rerank-reason
description: No memory construction: 60 candidate turns (BM25 and embeddings fused), a model keeps the 20 most useful, and the reader works through the evidence before answering.

name: dense-wide-reason
description: No memory construction: top 40 turns by embedding, and a reader that works through the evidence before answering.

name: raw-hybrid
description: No memory construction: BM25 and embeddings over the raw turns, fused.

name: raw-dense
description: No memory construction: embeddings over the raw turns.

name: raw-bm25
description: No memory construction: BM25 over the raw turns.
